description.zh: 密钥对的指纹。根据RFC4716定义的公钥指纹格式，采用MD5信息摘要算法。
description.en: The fingerprint of the key pair. The fingerprint is in the public key fingerprint format defined in RFC 4716 and uses the MD5 message digest algorithm.
The name of the key pair.

description.zh: 返回的最大数。取值范围：1~100。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 100.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用无需配置。
description.en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request.
The region ID of the key pair.

descriptions.zh: 您可以调用此接口获取云手机密钥对。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation to query cloud phone key pairs.
